capabilities: Manage installed plugins with search, filters, groups, tags and batch actions
Control plugin startup with delayed presets and on-demand loading
Install plugins and themes from GitHub releases and tracked sources
Export and import plugin setup packs across vaults
Diagnose plugin conflicts with guided split testing and reports
disambiguation: Not a general vault or note manager; it only manages Obsidian community plugins, themes and CSS snippets.
extras: No account, subscription or telemetry; GitHub token optional. Plugin store and version rollback are labeled Preview. Restore-point snapshots are unencrypted and may contain credentials; exclude .bpm/ from sync tools. BPM itself updates through Obsidian's native controls.
problem: Obsidian's native plugin settings only offer enable/disable toggles, so vaults with many plugins lack startup control, organization, batch actions and conflict isolation.

relations.evidence: The ribbon sorting feature is inspired by Obsidian-ribbon-sort
Install from GitHub repositories and release versions

summary: Control center for Obsidian community plugins: delayed startup, batch controls, groups, tags, device presets, GitHub installs and conflict diagnosis.
